items.title: Open weights vs. closed: An AI civil war's afoot, and the stakes are existential
items.summary: It started as China vs. the US, but it's become a face-off between two fundamentally different ways of building LLMs. And the safety of everything is on the line.

items.title: Hyundai reveals IONIQ 3 prices start at $30,000, and it already looks like a hit
items.summary: Hyundai says the IONIQ 3 is attracting more customer interest than any vehicle it’s ever launched. With over 300 miles of range, Hyundai’s new high-tech infotainment system, and a starting price around $30,000, the electric hatch checks all the boxes.
